stores.location: Directory object storage, key "rooms", one object named "home" (the binding DIRECTORY); a map from room id to its entry.

export.description: implementation/server/directory-migration.ts exportAll(rooms): a header line, then one room line per room in sorted id order with a sha256 over its canonical JSON. The application reads the map with storage.get("rooms") (for example from a protected route in a subclass of the directory class).

import.description: importAll(text) verifies header, count, checksums, duplicates and entry shape, then returns the map the application writes back with storage.put("rooms", rooms).

verification.checksums: sha256 per room entry over canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level)

cannotPreserve: rooms that changed while the export ran (they announce themselves again)

notes: The list is a summary the rooms re-announce, so it can be deleted with no lasting loss; afterRemovalDays is 0 for that reason. maxMegabytes is a planning figure chosen by this package (a list of a few thousand rooms), not a provider limit.
